category_title: Chamorro 5th-grade student with ADHD and literacy struggles who equates reading with pronunciation
scenario_title: Writing assignments and editing with an overemphasis on penmanship
minimal_context: Juan is working on a writing assignment in a small group setting and is asked to edit his story.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please write down your ideas for the story on your sheet of paper, and then review it to see what changes you can make.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Quickly scribbles a few words on the paper) Done! I finished it already.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's look at your story. What can you add to make the ideas more cohesive?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Erasing a word and rewriting it) I’ve seen my writing... My penmanship is not so good. I need to practice it.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We can worry about the handwriting later. Let's focus on adding more sentences to the story right now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: But Pedro always gets A’s for penmanship on his report card... I want to get A’s, too. I don't need to add more, I just need to make these letters look neater.

task.content: General classroom writing assignments, getting ideas onto paper, and editing the content of his writing
task.learning_goal: Developing cohesive ideas and using conventions appropriate to grade level

context.materials: Sheet of paper, writing assignments, copies of the legend

challenging_behavior_trigger.condition: When engaging in writing tasks and editing processes
challenging_behavior_trigger.observable_behavior: Rushes and produces work that is not to his full potential, ideas are not well developed or cohesive, does little editing to the content of his writing; changes made are to handwriting or spelling only
challenging_behavior_trigger.internal_state: Focuses heavily on form, rather than content; equates good writing with neat penmanship; describes himself as a poor writer because of poor penmanship
related_quotes: I’ve seen my writing... My penmanship is not so good. I need to practice it.
Pedro always gets A’s for penmanship on his report card... I want to get A’s, too.

behavior_patterns.condition: When impatience causes him to rush
behavior_patterns.observable_behavior: Produces work that is not to his full potential
